name: Dominican Republic

latest_census.notes: X Censo Nacional de Poblacion y Vivienda, enumerated November 2022 (previous: IX Censo 2010, VIII 2002). Ethnicity: the 2022 census introduced, for the first time in the country's census history, an ethnic-racial self-identification question (autoidentificacion etnico-racial, with categories on the order of negro/a, blanco/a, mestizo/a, indio/a, mulato/a, other) after years of advocacy by Afro-descendant organisations; the wording, and especially the 'indio' category, was publicly debated at the time. I recall results being released in 2023-2024 but not the geographic detail. Religion: not asked -- neither 2010 nor, on recollection, 2022 carried a religion item; the packet's Evangelical/Catholic shares are from an opinion survey. Language: not asked. The repo already found the US Census Bureau workbook for the Dominican Republic has no religion, ethnicity or language sheet.

subnational_sources.title: X Censo Nacional de Poblacion y Vivienda 2022 -- resultados: poblacion por autoidentificacion etnico-racial segun provincia (y municipio)
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (31 provinces + Distrito Nacional = 32 = 32); municipios (~158) approximately admin2 (155)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled that the question was asked and national results published; the existence of a provincial table, and its format (ONE distributes results as PDF reports, XLSX 'cuadros' and a REDATAM processor), is not established from memory. This is the item the runner should look for first on one.gob.do.

subnational_sources.title: ONE REDATAM online processor (Censo 2010 and, if loaded, Censo 2022)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: ONE has long exposed the 2010 census through REDATAM; the 2010 database has no ethnicity or religion variable, so it is only useful if the 2022 database is loaded. No API.

tier_reason: The 2022 census asked ethnic-racial self-identification for the first time, and ONE publishes census results by the 32 provinces (= admin1) and municipios (~158 vs 155 admin2), but I cannot confirm from memory that the ethnicity table is out below national level or in a machine-readable form; religion and language are not asked.
recommended_action: Crawl one.gob.do (Censos > Censo 2022 > resultados / cuadros) for the autoidentificacion etnico-racial tables by provincia and municipio; take XLSX if offered, else the PDF. Join admin1 on province names (accent-fold 'Sanchez Ramirez') and admin2 on municipio names (the boundary file drops accents: 'Cristobal', 'Sosua'). Keep 'no declarado' visible. Declare religion and language not_collected: no Dominican census asks them (confirm the 2022 boleta censal for religion before declaring).
not_found: Not established from memory: whether ONE has published the 2022 ethnic self-identification results by provincia or municipio, and in what format
Not established with certainty: that the 2022 questionnaire had no religion item (believed not)
summary: The Dominican Republic's ONE (one.gob.do) enumerated the X Censo in November 2022, which for the first time asked ethnic-racial self-identification; whether that table has been published by provincia (32 = admin1) or municipio (~158 vs 155 admin2), and in XLSX or PDF, I cannot confirm from memory, so Tier B until the runner checks. Religion and language are not census questions -- the packet's Evangelical/Catholic shares are survey figures -- and should be declared not_collected after a glance at the 2022 questionnaire. The USCB workbook route is already closed in the repo.
